import os
os.environ['HF_HOME'] = '/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache'
os.environ['HF_ENDPOINT'] = 'https://hf-mirror.com'
os.environ['HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET'] = '1'
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSeq2SeqLM, AutoModelForCausalLM
import time

print('=== Downloading T5-large tokenizer ===', flush=True)
t0 = time.time()
AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('google-t5/t5-large')
print(f'T5-large tokenizer done in {time.time()-t0:.1f}s', flush=True)

print('=== Downloading T5-large model ===', flush=True)
t0 = time.time()
AutoModelForSeq2SeqLM.from_pretrained('google-t5/t5-large')
print(f'T5-large model done in {time.time()-t0:.1f}s', flush=True)

print('=== Downloading pythia-410m tokenizer ===', flush=True)
t0 = time.time()
AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('EleutherAI/pythia-410m')
print(f'pythia-410m tokenizer done in {time.time()-t0:.1f}s', flush=True)

print('=== Downloading pythia-410m model ===', flush=True)
t0 = time.time()
AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained('EleutherAI/pythia-410m')
print(f'pythia-410m model done in {time.time()-t0:.1f}s', flush=True)

print('=== ALL DONE ===', flush=True)
" > /tmp/model_download.log 2>&1 &
echo "PID=$!"
